description: git_core CI boot-and-test profile (req-plugin-extdev-repo-ci; consumed by tap's plugin-ci.yml boot-and-test job). A substrate with no dependencies: installs git_core EDITABLE from _external/git_core (the path plugin-ci.yml checks this repo out to inside the harness tree) and nothing else above core, then runs this package's shipped suite. No population: git_core declares no GRIFT bundle (the kernel fixture is imported by tests, never seeded) and fires no collector, so there are no steps and no required_secrets.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.git_core). THIS repo's HEAD, editable. Install-only: no seed, no collector.
